PDF Volume Rendering using the Fourier Projection-Slice Theorem
Abstract The Fourier projection-slice theorem states that the inverse transform of a slice extracted from the frequency domain representation of a volume yields a projection of the volume in a direction perpendicular to the slice. This theorem allows the generation of attenuation-only renderings of volume data in \( O(N^2 \log N) \) time for a volume of size \( N^3 \). In this paper, we show ...
